$comment: P69 (lane `cs`, D-C-A-VA-LIST-REACHED-THROUGH-ITS-DECAYED-POINTER-READS-THE-POINTER-VARIABLE): on SysV x86-64 a `va_list` is an ARRAY of one tag (`__va_list_tag[1]`), so the list can be reached through its DECAYED pointer, a pointer to the tag, and every va_* operation made through it walks the SAME list. DSS read the pointer VARIABLE's own slot as the tag (va_arg through `__typeof__(&a[0]) p = a` answered 212 for 42, a va_copy into or from such a pointer 1, all with no diagnostic; HEAD 71648598's own binary answered 212 too) and refused a conditional of two lists (H_UnsupportedLoweringForKind). Five shapes, the exit code a bitmask of the ones that broke: 1 va_arg through the pointer (p and a are one list), 2 va_copy INTO the pointer, 4 va_copy FROM it, 8 a PARAMETER of the decayed type walked by va_arg, 16 a CONDITIONAL of two lists as the operand of va_copy, va_arg and va_end. Where the list is not an array (Win64's and Apple's `char *`, AAPCS64's structure) the shapes do not exist: the program is compiled out to `return 42` there, so only the SysV x86-64 target checks anything. MEASURED 2026-10-07 through `dssharness run probe-reference-cc`, this file: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 at -std=c17 -pedantic-errors and -std=c2x run the five shapes and exit 42 (run 20261007-001635-ec8e5da0); mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 both modes (run 20261007-001647-45f903f9) and MSVC 19.51 /std:clatest and /std:c17 (run 20261007-001648-743bf34c) build the compiled-out branch and exit 42. Every operand comes from argc. The release arm is REPORT-ONLY: its value is that the optimized pipeline keeps reading the tag through the pointer's value.
